teams.heading: Jake White brings back Nathan Hughes and names four uncapped Fiji players
teams.body: Former England international Nathan Hughes is back in the Fiji frame, drafted into a 35-man Nations Championship squad that includes three other uncapped players: Peniami Narisia, Marika Parker and Setareki Bituniyata. Hughes won 22 caps for England between 2016 and 2019, the last in the 38-38 draw with Scotland in the 2019 Six Nations. The squad follows the 34-28 win over Japan and faces France, Ireland and Italy, as Jake White looks to lift Fiji off the bottom of the Southern Hemisphere pool.

lead.why: It is the only new item on the shortlist and concerns Fiji's own squad selection.

teams.heading: Kepu Tuipulotu a doubt for Australia opener after knee injury in training
teams.body: Hooker Kepu Tuipulotu is a doubt for England's autumn campaign after a knee injury picked up in national training on Tuesday. The uncapped 21-year-old had been tipped to make his England breakthrough this autumn, but it is understood he will not be in the squad for the opener with Australia, and his return timeframe is unclear. Tuipulotu, who joined Bath's academy in 2024, also qualifies for Wales, the country of his birth, but chose to focus on England.

teams.heading: Tadhg Furlong cleared of groin-grab citation, available for Ireland's November Tests
teams.body: Tadhg Furlong has been cleared by a disciplinary committee of grabbing Gavin Coombes in the groin during Leinster's URC win over Munster, with the complaint against the Ireland prop dismissed after a hearing on Thursday. The panel unanimously concluded he did not commit foul play under Law 9.27, though it described Coombes' account as an honest recollection. Furlong, 33, avoided a sanction and is available for Ireland's Nations Championship home matches against Argentina, Fiji and South Africa, plus the finals weekend at Twickenham.

lead.why: The disciplinary ruling clearing Tadhg Furlong is the freshest Ireland story in the pack and directly affects his availability for the November Tests.

teams.heading: Lodi names Italy Under 18 side to face Ireland at Badia Polesine
teams.body: Italy Under 18s are the story today: technical director Alessandro Lodi has named his XV for Saturday's test against Ireland at Badia Polesine, in the Rovigo province. Lodi said he expects an intense game at high tempo and under pressure, and wants his players to show courage, personality and their own style of play. The fixture is a year on from the last meeting, a 54-14 Italy win in Cosenza.

lead.why: It is the only genuinely new Italy item in the pack that is not a club story, and it is labelled as an age-grade fixture.

teams.heading: Former Scotland winger Tim Visser enters not guilty plea to abuse charges
teams.body: Tim Visser has entered a not guilty plea to abuse charges spanning 14 years, and is due to stand trial on charges including rape and controlling behaviour. The former Scotland winger, who also played for Harlequins, faces the allegations with no verdict reached. Today's coverage gives no trial date, so the case stays open until a court rules.

teams.heading: Macs Page earns Wales call-up as injured Rio Dyer's replacement
teams.body: Scarlets wing Macs Page has been called into Wales' squad to replace the injured Dragons wing Rio Dyer, and Scarlets director of rugby Nigel Davies expects his first cap to come "sooner rather than later". The 21-year-old has scored five tries this season, and could make his debut against Japan after a head knock in Scarlets' 52-40 defeat by the Stormers. He was helped off with oxygen but returned to light training before joining Wales, Davies said. Page previously toured Japan with Wales in 2025.

lead.why: A new Wales men's squad call-up, with Davies' view that Page will debut soon, is the freshest story about the national team's own selection.

teams.heading: Thomas Gallo's injury sees Rodrigo Martínez called into Pumas London camp
teams.body: Thomas Gallo, the Lyon prop, has been lost to injury, and Rodrigo Martínez (Dragons) has been brought onto Argentina's 33-man roster for the London camp, reported on 25 October. Santiago Carreras was also lost to injury, with Mateo Soler (Dogos) taking his place. Gallo's injury timeline has not been reported in today's coverage, so whether he is available for the Nations Championship remains open. Felipe Contepomi will name his November squad after the camp.

teams.heading: Les Kiss says Kurtley Beale is in contention for the World Cup
teams.body: Wallabies coach Les Kiss has made clear Kurtley Beale is in contention for the World Cup, not just to fill a void on the spring tour. The 37-year-old, who has 95 Test caps, was added after Hunter Paisami withdrew for personal reasons. "He's in there to perform," Kiss said, and he will reassess the No. 10 position after the next Super Rugby Pacific season. The tour takes in Tests against England, Scotland and Wales.

lead.why: It is the only NEW item in the shortlist, and it adds Kiss's first explicit statement that Beale is in contention for the World Cup squad.

teams.heading: Dave Rennie names 36-man squad for northern tour, recalling Leicester Fainga'anuku
teams.body: New Zealand's 36-man squad for the northern leg of the Nations Championship has been named, with Codie Taylor again captaining the side against Scotland, Wales and England. Rennie has had to work through a long injury list, with Samisoni Taukei'aho, Shannon Frizell, Ruben Love, Ardie Savea and Luke Jacobson among those sidelined. Leicester Fainga'anuku is back after a broken leg, and Christian Lio-Willie earns his first selection under Rennie. Patrick Tuipulotu and Du'Plessis Kirifi miss out.

lead.why: The squad announcement is a fresh event, and it carries the injury list, Fainga'anuku's return and the omissions that matter most to fans.

teams.heading: Rassie Erasmus names Malcolm Marx and Jan-Hendrik Wessels as only Springbok hookers
teams.body: Malcolm Marx and Jan-Hendrik Wessels are the two hookers in Rassie Erasmus' 37-man squad for the November leg of the Nations Championship. Nick Mallett is uneasy about that, finding it strange not to take three specialist hookers. He is happy to see Wessels picked as a hooker rather than a hybrid loosehead, and notes that Marco van Staden, among the utility forwards, has covered hooker before. Bongi Mbonambi, now at the Stormers, is on the bench against Ulster this weekend.

lead.why: The squad announcement's hooker selection is the most talked-about call in the new November squad, and it is a concrete event rather than a rehash of the earlier coverage.
